_comment: Human value choices for the apply-queue refresh (all your-input). Each is a [TODO: DEFINE] in the recipe, closed by Hemanth Rayudu on 2026-10-19 with the reasoning given here.

time_to_start_days.why: The persona's gaps.md says big-company hiring loops take 6-10 weeks; 42 days is the short end. The report also shows the factor at 35 days (her own target) and 70 days (the long end), so the choice stays visible.

unemployment_days_as_of.why: profile.yml gives a count of unemployment days used but no date for it, so the count is read as of the run date and labeled as an assumption.

timeline.why: 0 if the expected start is after the authorization end or the unemployment ceiling is reached before it; otherwise min(1, unemployment days left at the start / buffer target). Chapter 10 gives the inputs and the 0-1 range, not a formula.

liveness.why: A posting is live only when the page check and the board API agree; disagreement or 'uncertain' goes to the human (investigate), because the engine scorer would silently treat a missing gate as 1.0.

fit.why: The greenhouse-watch score divided by the most that scheme can award (13.0 for scheme default-0.1), so fit stays within 0-1 without changing the scheme.

report_fields.reader: the student who owns the queue
report_fields.decision: which rows to release for applying this week (gate G3)
report_fields.why: Each column is one input the release decision needs, with its label; the sections that follow hold the refusals, the closed postings, the changes since the last refresh, the deciding sentences, the clock arithmetic and the BLS context.
